title: Model-agnostic noise reduction for high-dimensional time series data
abstract: arXiv:2609.27614v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We develop a model-agnostic framework for noise reduction in high-dimensional time series that explicitly targets optimal recovery of a low-dimensional latent dynamic component contaminated by observational white noise. Under the assumption that the latent dynamics live in a low-dimensional linear dynamic subspace, we characterize the optimal linear projection onto the dynamic subspace and provide a geometric description of the residual error in terms of the relative orientation of the signal and noise spaces. We propose estimators for the dynamic subspace and the optimal projection based on lagged covariance matrices, bootstrap dimension selection, and a low-rank representation of the structured noise. Under mild conditions, the resulting denoised series is shown to converge to its population target at the usual parametric rate. Simulations show that the proposed method can substantially improve subspace estimation, reconstruction err

translated_title: 面向高维时间序列数据的模型无关降噪方法
translated_abstract: 我们开发了一个模型无关的框架，用于高维时间序列的降噪，该框架明确针对被观测白噪声污染的低维潜在动态分量实现最优恢复。在潜在动态存在于低维线性动态子空间的假设下，我们刻画了到动态子空间的最优线性投影，并从信号空间与噪声空间相对方向的角度给出了残差的几何描述。我们提出了动态子空间及最优投影的估计方法，其基于滞后协方差矩阵、bootstrap维数选择以及结构化噪声的低秩表示。在温和条件下，所得的去噪序列被证明以通常的参数速率收敛到其总体目标。仿真结果表明，所提出的方法能够显著改善子空间估计与重构误差。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个模型无关的高维时间序列降噪框架，通过刻画低维动态子空间上的最优线性投影，并基于滞后协方差矩阵、bootstrap维数选择和噪声低秩表示进行估计，在温和条件下证明了去噪序列以参数速率收敛到总体目标。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a model-agnostic framework for denoising high-dimensional time series by characterizing the optimal linear projection onto a low-dimensional dynamic subspace, with estimators based on lagged covariance matrices, bootstrap dimension selection, and low-rank noise representation, provably converging at the parametric rate.
